思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S25 「比昨天更早的医院条目在 36 h（±1 h）时清掉」 Hospital entries older than yesterday are cleared at 36 h (±1 h)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T5 Hospital: entries older than yesterday are cleared, not only hidden from view.（TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment；TFA-94699 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.6；TFA-92589 AC 4）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital patient whose course was last refreshed at T

When Age the data to T+35 h and to T+37 h and query the stored course

Then At T+37 h, entries older than yesterday are gone from storage and from the editor, not only hidden from the cards; at T+35 h nothing is cleared early

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：rounding:get after aging: course has no line older than yesterday (TFA-94699 AC 1 'queryable as gone'). Scope is Q2. If Q2's answer also covers the handoff and model context, add: seed a '{day-3}' line with a distinctive event, generate the handoff, and check it does not mention that event (buildHandoff.ts takes the last 3 course lines with no date window)
